none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable convex function f: ℝ^d → ℝ with differentiable gradient and an attained global minimum. Strong convexity is not assumed.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ZerothOrderMatrixGeneralizedSmooth.lean: spec.admissible, ConvexOn, HasGradientAt, Differentiable, and IsMinOn conditions.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: A query at any x ∈ ℝ^d returns exactly f(x), independently of call index and oracle seed. No gradient or matrix oracle is supplied. The budget counts individual function evaluations and is bounded for every seed.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ZerothOrderMatrixGeneralizedSmooth.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, and spec.admissible oracle equality; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: There exists a fixed hidden symmetric positive-definite H with H ≼ I and tr(H) ≤ r. Writing ‖g‖_{H⁻¹} = √⟨H⁻¹g,g⟩, the certificate condition is equivalent to c ≥ ‖∇f(x)‖_{H⁻¹}. The derivative satisfies |⟨D∇f(x)v,w⟩| ≤ (L0 + L1‖∇f(x)‖_{H⁻¹})‖v‖_H‖w‖_H for all x,v,w. Here L0 > 0 and L1 ≥ 0.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ZerothOrderMatrixGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Certifies; spec.valid and spec.admissible matrix and derivative conditions.

distinctive_assumptions.label: non_euclidean_geometry
distinctive_assumptions.details: Smoothness uses the hidden matrix norm ‖v‖_H and its dual gradient norm. The matrix obeys μI ≼ H ≼ I for some hidden μ > 0, with public trace bound r > 0. Neither H nor μ is supplied to the algorithm; the initial distance bound uses the Euclidean norm.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ZerothOrderMatrixGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, and existential H and μ in spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), with public integer dimension d > 0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public inputs are d, L0, L1, r, R, Δ, ε, δ, and x0. A common global minimizer xstar satisfies ‖x0 − xstar‖ ≤ R and f(x0) − f(xstar) ≤ Δ, with R, Δ > 0. The minimizer and optimal value are not supplied.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ZerothOrderMatrixGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, and final existential clause of spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point-valued output x with f(x) − f(xstar) ≤ ε on the success event, where ε > 0 and xstar is a global minimizer.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: The probability of f(output) − f(xstar) > ε is at most δ, with 0 < δ < 1. Probability is taken over the algorithm and oracle seed laws; exact oracle replies do not eliminate possible algorithmic randomness.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ZerothOrderMatrixGeneralizedSmooth.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence product probability law.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines exact function-value access with gradient-dependent smoothness in a hidden matrix geometry and a public trace bound. These are substantive additional structural conditions beyond classical smooth convex zeroth-order optimization.
